'''Samir Bousenine''' (born 7 February 1991) is an Andorran international [[association football|footballer]] who plays for [[Inter Club d'Escaldes]], as a [[Midfielder#Winger|right winger]].

==Career==
Bousenine has played for [[FC Andorra]], [[FC Santa Coloma]], [[TF Croix-Daurade]], [[AS Tournefeuille]], [[US Revel]], [[FC Lusitanos]], [[UE Engordany]] and [[Inter Club d'Escaldes]].<ref name = "NFT">{{NFT player|pid=38593|accessdate=16 November 2018}}</ref>

He made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in 2010.<ref name = "NFT"/>
